      $(document).ready(function() {
      var source = document.getElementById("list-template").innerHTML;
      Handlebars.registerHelper('concat', function(prefix, id) {
           return (prefix + id);
      });
      Handlebars.registerHelper('getLocale', function(model, attributeName) {
          var currentLang = themeDisplay.getLanguageId();
          if(currentLang=='es_ES'){
              attributeName=attributeName+'CAS';
          }
          if(currentLang=='eu_ES'){
              attributeName=attributeName+'EUS';
          }
          return model[attributeName];
      });
      Handlebars.registerHelper('ifEquals', function(arg1, arg2,
  					options) {
  				return (arg1 == arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options
  						.inverse(this);
  			});
      Handlebars.registerHelper('estadoColor', function(estado) {
    	  if (String(estado).toUpperCase() === 'ABIERTO') {
    	    return 'color: green;';
    	  } else if (String(estado).toUpperCase() === 'CERRADO') {
    	    return 'color: red;';
    	  } else {
    	    return '';
    	  }
    	});

      Handlebars.registerHelper('pdfCreator', function(pdf, fileName) {
      	const linkSource = 'data:application/pdf;base64,';
      	const downloadLink = document.createElement("a");
      	downloadLink.href = linkSource;
      	downloadLink.download = fileName;
      	downloadLink.click();
    	});

      Handlebars.registerHelper('downloadPdf', function(pdf) {
      	return 'data:application/pdf;base64,';
    	});


      Handlebars.registerHelper('formatDate', function(dateString) {
     	 if (dateString === null) {
     		    return null;
     		  }
     	  if (dateString.length === 8) {

     	    const year = dateString.slice(0, 4);
     	    const month = dateString.slice(4, 6);
     	    const day = dateString.slice(6, 8);
			var currentLang = themeDisplay.getLanguageId();
			if(currentLang=='es_ES'){
			  return day + '/' + month + '/' + year;
          	}
          	if(currentLang=='eu_ES'){
      		  return year + '/' + month + '/' + day;
          	}
     	  } else {
     	    return dateString;
     	  }
     	});



      Handlebars.registerHelper('checkDateRange', function(startDate, endDate) {
  	      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
  	      if (startDate === null || endDate === null || startDate.length !== 8 || endDate.length !== 8) {
  	        return null;
  	      }
  	      return startDate <= today && today <= endDate;
  	    });
      
      Handlebars.registerHelper('slugify', function(text) {
    	    return text
    	        .toString() /* Convertir a string */
    	        .toLowerCase() /* Convertir a minï¿½sculas */
    	        .normalize('NFD') /* Normalizar caracteres con acentos */
    	        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '') /* Eliminar marcas diacrï¿½ticas */
    	        .replace(/ï¿½/g, 'n') /* Reemplazar ï¿½ por n */
    	        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-') /* Reemplazar caracteres especiales por guiones */
    	        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); /* Eliminar guiones al inicio y al final */
    	});
      
      Handlebars.registerHelper('eq', function(a, b) {
    	  return a === b;
    	});
      
      Handlebars.registerHelper('hayDocumentosConUrl', function(documentacion, options) {

    	  if (!documentacion || !documentacion.condicionesDocumentos) {
    	    return options.inverse(this);
    	  }

    	  const hay = documentacion.condicionesDocumentos.some(function(cond) {
    	    return cond.documentosPorCondicion &&
    	           cond.documentosPorCondicion.some(function(doc) {
    	             return doc.urlDocumento && doc.urlDocumento.trim() !== '';
    	           });
    	  });
		  
    	  return hay ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
    	});

      function initScript() {
          $('.tablinks').on('click' , function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              var i, tabcontent, tablinks;
              tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tabcontent");
              for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
                  tabcontent[i].style.display = "none";
              }
              tablinks = document.getElementsByClassName("tablinks_active");
              for (i = 0; i < tablinks.length; i++) {
                  tablinks[i].classList.remove("tablinks_active");
              }
              document.getElementById(($(this).attr('data-target'))).style.display = "block";
              var button = document.getElementById($(this).attr('id'));
              button.classList.add("tablinks_active");
          });

      }
